title: Header controls named by their visible text
assertion: Each header control's accessible name starts with its visible text and contains every other piece of it (WCAG 2.5.3) at 1280 and 390 px; axe 4.14 with the WCAG 2.0/2.1 A and AA tags finds no violation on any page a journey scans, each scanned once it has its title (the one the journey names, where it names one), so a page a client-side navigation has just committed is not scanned before its title is in the head
noFileReason: The brand journey reads the header's accessible names and visible text in the browser, and every journey's axe scan reads its pages; no file.
